# LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)

> Columbia College's comprehensive research and academic support platform providing subject guides, course resources, citation tools, and student learning materials.

LibGuides at Columbia College (BC) serves students and faculty with curated research resources, academic databases, and instructional guides across multiple disciplines. The platform emphasizes information literacy, academic integrity, and research skills development through course-specific guides and topical resource collections.

## Key Topics

- APA Citation (7th edition)
- Academic Databases
- Research Skills
- Academic Integrity
- Plagiarism Prevention
- JSTOR
- EBSCO
- Course Guides
- Subject Guides
- Library Resources
- Canada Commons
- ProQuest
- Citation Guides
- Information Literacy
- Student Support

## Core Resources & Navigation

- [Home - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com): Columbia College LibGuides homepage providing access to research resources and subject guides
- [A-Z Databases](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/az.php): Directory of academic databases including JSTOR, EbscoHOST, Gale, Canada Commons

## Citation & Academic Writing

- [Welcome - APA Citation Guide (7th edition) - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/apa): Comprehensive APA 7th edition citation guide for academic writing and research papers
- [Home - Research Skills Tutorial - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/research_skills): Research skills tutorial covering citation guides, source evaluation, and APA/MLA/Chicago

## Academic Integrity & Plagiarism

- [Home - Plagiarism Resources - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/plagiarism): Plagiarism resources covering academic integrity, citation help, and cheating policy
- [1. Plagiarism: What's it About? - Avoiding Plagiarism - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/avoidingplagiarism): Educational guide on plagiarism definition and academic integrity for students

## Course & Subject Guides

- [Home - HIST 202 (World History since 1500) Course Guide - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/hist202): HIST 202 course guide featuring primary sources and historical research databases
- [Home - HIST 120 (Canada from 1867) Course Guide - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/hist120-meghan): HIST 120 Canadian history course guide with academic databases and resources
- [Home - SOCI 230 (Sociology of Work) Course Guide - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/Sociology230): SOCI 230 course guide with journal access and academic database resources
- [Home - ANTH 230 (Introduction to Economic Anthropology) Course Guide - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/anth230): ANTH 230 course guide with research resources and citation guidance
- [Start Here - Psychology - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/psychology): Psychology research guide with EBSCO databases and APA citation resources
- [Home - ARTH 100 (History of Art) Course Guide - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/Art100): ARTH 100 course guide with art databases and research resources
- [Home - ARTH 210 (Contemporary Art in Canada) Course Guide - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/art210): ARTH 210 course guide for contemporary Canadian art research and resources
- [Home - ARTH 220 (Renaissance Art in Europe) Course Guide - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/art_220): ARTH 220 Renaissance art course guide with research resources and recommended books

## Student Support & Skills Development

- [Need Help Now? - Mental Health and Wellness Resources - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/mentalhealthresources): Mental health and crisis support resources for Columbia College students
- [Home - Giving Presentations - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/presentations): Student guide for presentation skills, public speaking, and delivery tips

## Faculty & Instructional Resources

- [Welcome - Designing Research Assignments - LibGuides at Columbia College (BC)](https://columbiacollege-ca.libguides.com/designing_assignments): Faculty guide for designing research assignments with information literacy focus
